# Remove Floaters

Deletes stray splats floating in empty space, such as specks in the sky or haze below the ground.

`lfs.remove_floaters` · Clean-up

## How to use

Turn on Preview first: it shows only what would be removed.\
Isolation Radius 3 with 'Relative to size' judges each splat at its own scale, so the sparse background survives.\
Connect a Selection to limit the clean-up, for example to heights below the ground.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Where you test for removal: weights of 0.5 or more. Unconnected tests every splat. |
| Min Opacity | `Min Opacity` | lfs.float | 0.02 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Remove splats below this opacity, 0–1. 0 disables this test; 0.02, the default, removes very faint splats. |
| Max Size | `Max Size` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.01 | Remove splats whose longest axis exceeds this many scene units. 0, the default, disables this test. |
| Isolation Radius | `Isolation Radius` | lfs.float | 3 | min 0; step 0.1 | How far to look for neighbours. With 'Relative to size' it is a multiple of each splat's size; otherwise scene units. 0 turns the test off. |
| Min Neighbours | `Min Neighbours` | lfs.int | 1 | min 0; step 1 | A splat with fewer neighbours than this inside the radius is removed. 1 removes only completely isolated splats. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Preview | `preview` | bool | false | — | Show only the splats you would remove, unchanged. Off by default shows the cleaned result. |
| Relative To Size | `relative_to_size` | bool | true | — | Use each splat's size as the radius unit. On by default protects sparse areas; off uses scene units. |
